inventionTitles.title: Lithium ion battery with inorganic isolation layers, and method and device for manufacturing lithium ion battery

address.address1: Three Beijing 100018 Chaoyang District city high poplar town of Chaoyang 7-5603

event-title.$: REJECTION OF INVENTION PATENT APPLICATION AFTER PUBLICATION

section.content: The invention discloses a lithium ion battery with inorganic isolation layers, and a method and a device for manufacturing the lithium ion battery. High-temperature-resistant insulating inorganic compound materials are coated on pole pieces of a battery to form the lithium ion battery. The lithium ion battery, the method and the device have the advantages that membranes are replaced by the inorganic coating layers, so that positive and negative electrodes can be electronically insulated, and ions of the positive and negative electrodes can be conducted after electrolyte is absorbed; electronic insulation faults of the inorganic coating layers can be prevented at the high temperatures of 200 Celsius degrees, accordingly, internal short circuit of the lithium ion battery at the high temperatures of 200 Celsius degrees can be assuredly prevented, and the safety performance of the lithium ion battery can be greatly improved.

Inorganic barrier lithium ion battery and production method and process unitsTechnical field

The present invention relates to a kind of lithium ion battery, be related specifically to a kind of aseptate lithium ion battery.

Background technology

Lithium ion battery is made up of positive pole, negative pole, barrier film, electrolyte, shell etc. usually, makes the conducting of both positive and negative polarity ion after the effect of its septation mainly makes both positive and negative polarity electronic isolation, Electolyte-absorptive.Barrier film is normally made up of the how empty material of macromolecule, the usual non-refractory of macromolecular material, generally there will be thawing exceeding uniform temperature, and diaphragm material PP, PE as conventional there will be thawing in temperature more than 140 degrees Celsius.There is micro-short circuit in lithium ion battery such as inside, barrier film is melted in localized hyperthermia, causes inside lithium ion cell short circuit, has a strong impact on the safety of lithium ion battery.

Summary of the invention

The object of this invention is to provide a kind of aseptate lithium ion battery, improve the high temperature safe performance of lithium ion battery.

The present invention is realized by inorganic compound material that is high temperature resistant in battery pole piece coating, insulation.Inorganic coat replaces after barrier film realizes making both positive and negative polarity electronic isolation, Electolyte-absorptive makes the conducting of both positive and negative polarity ion.Can not there is electronic isolation fault in inorganic coat, can ensure that lithium ion battery there will not be internal short-circuit under the high temperature of 200 degrees Celsius, greatly improve the security performance of lithium ion battery under the high temperature of 200 degrees Celsius.

The coating slurry of the inorganic coat of electrodes of lithium-ion batteries is by inorganic compound powder, adhesive, solvent composition.Inorganic compound powder is one or more mixtures of the inorganic compounds such as alundum (Al2O3), silicon dioxide, titanium dioxide, magnesium oxide, barium titanate, alumina silicate, micro mist size be 1 nanometer to 50 microns, micro mist shape can be spherical, block, fibrous etc.Adhesive mates with solvent, can be water system as CMC, SBR etc., also can be that organic system is as PVDF+NMP, PVDF+DMF etc.The adhesive of coat and the ratio of inorganic powder are 1:2 to 1:999.The coating method of the inorganic coat of electrodes of lithium-ion batteries can be the modes such as spraying, brushing, roller coat.Coating drying can be heated-air drying, infrared heating drying, micro-wave drying or combination drying etc.Coat can compacting also can not compacting, compacting mode can roll extrusion also can concora crush.

Electrodes of lithium-ion batteries coating inorganic coat can be that anode pole piece dual coating cathode pole piece does not apply, cathode pole piece dual coating anode pole piece does not apply, both positive and negative polarity pole piece respectively applies all dual coating or the one side coatings of a dual coating of one side, both positive and negative polarity pole piece.

Aseptate inorganic barrier lithium ion battery can be cylindrical battery also can be rectangular cell or Special-shaped battery, can be winding battery also can be laminated batteries, can be duricrust battery also can be flexible-packed battery.

The battery system of aseptate inorganic barrier lithium ion battery can be lithium iron phosphate/carbon, ternary/carbon also can be LiFePO4/lithium titanate, ternary/lithium titanate or other systems.

Production without barrier film lithium ion battery mainly can be divided into four technological processes: pole piece making, assembling, fluid injection, change into.Described pole piece makes and is divided into anode pole piece to make making with cathode pole piece, and the main flow that anode pole piece makes is: aluminium foil unreels, anode sizing agent apply, pole piece drying, pole piece compacting, inorganic insulation slurry apply, pole piece drying, pole piece are shaping.The main flow that cathode pole piece makes is: Copper Foil unreels, cathode size apply, pole piece drying, pole piece compacting, inorganic insulation slurry apply, pole piece drying, pole piece is shaping.Described is equipped with two kinds of assembling modes, and one is the takeup type assembly technology of cylindrical battery, and one is the stacked assembly technology of rectangular cell.Winding process is that both positive and negative polarity pole piece stacks direct winding, does not need to put barrier film between both positive and negative polarity.Lamination process is that both positive and negative polarity pole piece is stacked alternately, and does not have barrier film between both positive and negative polarity.Fluid injection, change into identical with traditional lithium-ion battery technique.

The process units with inorganic coat pole piece forms primarily of unwinding device, slurry coating apparatus, drying device, compaction apparatus and pole piece shaped device.Collector metallic foil launches by unwinding device primary responsibility, and unwinding device has deviation correcting device and tenslator.Slurry coating apparatus is responsible for slurry to be coated to be evenly coated to metallic foil surface.Drying device is responsible for the slurry drying of coating, and drying mode can be heated-air drying, infrared heating drying, micro-wave drying or combination drying etc.Compaction apparatus is responsible for pole piece compacting, compacting mode can roll extrusion also can concora crush.Pole piece shaped device is responsible for pole piece excision forming.The device of inorganic coating pole piece production line is arranged in the following manner: unwinding device, active material slurry coating unit, drying device, compaction apparatus, inorganic insulation slurry coating apparatus, drying device, pole piece shaped device.
